title: Research construction: save 20 R439 mini-node XORs (no new kappa)
head: d454ae19fdd474b4dfa7bd2c28bbe5b0996365fb
body:
This **finite bit-circuit construction** saves **20 scalar XORs** in the merged PR589 punctured R439 word. Two phase-A mini-nodes go from 20 to 14 and 13 to 9 XORs; their complete literal reverse cleanup saves ten more. Including scatter, the native word goes from **24,305 to 24,285 XORs**.

The contribution exhausts all **186** destination-basis factorizations for the four two- or three-destination mini-nodes. The minima are restricted to preparation, read-only external injection and recombination, with no new wires or external mutations. All 661 dirty-input columns, every register's frame path, 439 helpers, nine retained copy ranks of seven and the paid profile are preserved. Frames 507 and 508 have no improvement in this class.

**No new bit exponent or kappa is claimed.** Cancellation-free row norms increase on some destinations; hosted recursive coefficient bills have not been recertified. This limitation and its exact witnesses are recorded alongside the reduction.

Base: `66849e1475c930fd7732b1a0067ffee7e1e95f60`. Assignment seed: **8**, OS randomness, bit-supplier track. Sources are pinned in `research/p111-mini-node-basis/certificate.json`. No selected construction, upstream source or existing generated artifact changes.

Reproduce from the repository root:

```sh
python3 -B research/p111-mini-node-basis/verify.py
```

Expected: `PASS_P111_MINI_NODE_BASIS`, 186 candidates, 20 XORs saved, 661 columns, unchanged frame paths/profile, independent interface acceptance and four negative controls.

Validation completed:

- Local exact synthesis and dirty-column replay, also under Python isolated mode.
- Unchanged PR555/PR589 independent E8 checker: 636 closed frames, all H1-H5 hypotheses and all U/J/K/C conclusions pass.
- Controls reject omitted preparation, omitted cleanup and illegal frame descent. A stale-cleanup control passes the endpoint test but fails the literal-reversal requirement.
- Separate agent review independently enumerated the minima and checked all 2,048 and 512 local Boolean inputs of the changed nodes.
- `make selected-record-check` and `git diff --cached --check` pass.

The repository-wide `make verify`, expanded hosting replays and recursive coefficient bills were not run. This isolated local contribution does not modify the selected supplier or its certificate.

Credit: eumemic's PR543/PR555; DreamingOfClouds' PR545/PR510/PR589, with the retained upstream notices. Concurrent PR670 and PR713 are credited as related finite-circuit work. This result adds different, punctured-word mini-nodes and an exhaustive small-group comparison. The final overlap check also inspected newly arrived PR717 and PR720; their claims concern different objects.

Contributor: `thakrarsagar`, with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance for implementation, proof analysis, documentation and independent agent review. Apache-2.0. No pinned sprint coordination issue exists; the claim is recorded locally in `CLAIM.md`.
limits: Metadata and source identity only. Checks require source/command/coverage review; no green-badge inference.
